about_the_game:
Welcome to the town of Red Iron. While small and unassuming at first glance, it has been home to several mysteries over the years. Most people don't want to bother with poking their noses into the strange happenings, but there are some exceptions.

Enter Andrew Connor, whose entire life changed one fateful night in 1995, but he has a hard time remembering why. With his life upside down and his fiance dead, he looks to the past with hopes of putting it to rest, permanently.

Remember

Follow Andrew through the course of his investigation to find out what happened that night, and maybe uncover a few additional mysteries along the way.

Investigate

Not everything you need will be right at your fingertips. Sneak around, collect evidence, put the pieces together, and solve the mystery.

Don't Get Caught

Not everyone will be thrilled with your activities, and there may even be someone looking to put an end to your investigation before it even starts. Will you be able to solve the mystery and get out in one piece?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04
  • Processor: 2 GHz Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7770
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Device capable of 44,100 Hz playback
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3 Required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Intel Core i5 4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 780 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound Device capable of 44,100 Hz playback
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL 3.3 Required

short_description: Enter a small town filled with mysteries to help Andrew Connor solve one of his own. Work your way through the past and help put it, and the people involved, to rest for good. Be careful though, since not everyone wants this investigation to reach its conclusion.
